notes: ID partition verified: s001-s009 and t001-t018 each appear exactly once.
The marginal readings ('the pure of heart'; 'Hath grace in his lips') were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
Variant WLC.PRO.22.11.v003 is selected to the base reading, which the alignment follows (rule 9).

Competing reading worth recording under rule 8: rea'ehu is definite and melekh anarthrous, which by the ordinary definiteness test would make melekh the predicate and give it the supplied 'will be', leaving rea'ehu the bare 'friend'. The accepted division follows the ASV's own construal of melekh as subject, which rule 20 permits since the translation's reading of which side predicates is itself a reading of the Hebrew; the alternative is genuinely defensible and is named here rather than silently dropped.
